Main colors: paper #f7f4ec, ink #263c34, jade #37594a, old gold #a78046, vermilion #a64936, water teal #426e78. Strong clear symbol legible at 64 pixels; restrained detail, no noisy filigree. Three large curling ochre cloud strokes and a few angular ink stone splinters convey devastating downward weight. Staff and mountain impact are the clear silhouette. No character.
